recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, playful composition featuring a central photographic subject in a dynamic, inverted pose, surrounded by a whimsical 'space' environment consisting of hand-drawn planets, stars, and vibrant, multi-colored custom lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure framed by an arch formed by their own legs
Contrast between realistic photography and flat, doodle-style illustrations
Symmetrical placement of secondary text elements flanking the subject
Floating celestial objects creating a loose circular frame around the center
coreInvariants: White hand-drawn outline tracing the subject's silhouette
Rainbow color gradients applied to typography
Doodle-style planets with visible sketch lines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central figure in an inverted, wide-legged stance occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, framed between their hands and legs at the lower-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top title, follows the legs down to the face, then radiates outward to the flanking text and floating planets.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample neutral beige space allows the colorful doodles and text to pop without visual clutter.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral beige (background) providing a clean canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and white (subject's clothing) grounding the image.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant rainbow spectrum (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple) used in text and doodles.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements against a low-saturation, mid-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid muddy or earth tones in the graphic elements

letterConstructionRules: Varying color gradients within individual words
Small starburst icons integrated into or surrounding the letterforms
Heavy, rounded outlines for secondary text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A fluid, horizontal display script paired with chunky, arched bubble letters for secondary emphasis.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, circular nature of the display text.
Matches the secondary arched text style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a person in an inverted wide-legged pose against a solid beige backdrop. Add hand-drawn doodle planets, stars, and a globe at the bottom in a sketchy, vibrant style. Include a thin white hand-drawn outline around the person's silhouette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom rainbow-gradient lettering. The main title should be a fluid, lowercase script at the top. Secondary text should be thick, arched bubble letters flanking the subject's legs.

verificationChecks: Is the background a clean, neutral beige?
Does the main title feature a multi-color gradient?
Is there a white hand-drawn outline around the central figure?
Are the planets and stars rendered in a 'doodle' or 'sketch' style?

adjustableVariables: Specific gradient colors in the text

mustAchieve: Clean separation between photo and graphics

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite the rainbow gradient.
Check that the white outline follows the subject accurately.
Verify the 'doodle' elements look hand-drawn rather than clip-art.
Confirm the composition feels balanced and symmetrical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dynamic studio portrait with a neutral background, add a hand-drawn silhouette outline, and surround with vibrant, rainbow-gradient Y2K-style doodles and custom bubble lettering.
